test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The _________ is/are given for outstanding performance in sports and games over a period of the previous four years and for showing qualities of leadership, sportsmanship and a sense of discipline.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjuna Awards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given for outstanding performance in sports and games over the previous four years.
 
• Recognizes qualities of leadership, sportsmanship, and a sense of discipline.
 
• **Instituted in 1961** by the Government of India.
 
• Awarded annually by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• **Last winner (2023)**: Mohammed Shami (Cricket), among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar**: Given to organizations for their contribution to sports promotion and development.

 
 
• **Last winner (2022)**: TransStadia Enterprises Private Limited.
 
• **Ministry**: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Awards**: Given to coaches for producing medal winners at prestigious international sports events.
 
 
• **Last winner (2023)**: Jaskirat Singh Grewal (Golf), Bhaskaran E (Kabaddi), Jayant Kumar Pushilal (Table Tennis).
 
• **Ministry**: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 
 
• **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy**: Awarded to the university with the best overall performance in inter-university tournaments.
 
 
• **Last winner (2023)**: Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar.
 
• **Ministry**: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
